script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl48_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("51-2");
		    if dialog.show("Level48-1", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level48-2", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level48-3", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level48-4", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("50-1");
		    if dialog.show("Level48-5", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level48-6", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level48-7", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("60-2");
			if dialog.show("Level48-8", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl48_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
